audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-4 all disagree with the packet chart, the mirror and our own whys[]. whys[0] says Level 1 is yours while the row says Skill; whys[1] and whys[2] call 2 and 3 even while the rows say Yorick; whys[3] calls Level 4 Wukong's spike while the row says Skill; whys[4] gives Level 6 to Yorick while the row says Skill.
audit.why: Every one of these rows renders directly above the sentence contradicting it, and the mirror has already committed to the packet sides.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 -> Yorick, rows 1 and 2 -> Skill, row 3 -> Wukong, as matched full/content pairs with ratings, proposed as one chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 4 was rated 6/10 (comfortable) despite being his all-in window, and Level 6 rated 6/10 despite Maiden flipping it to you.
audit.why: His spike is W plus the Crushing Blow armour shred at 4; yours is Eulogy of the Isles on 160/130/100s, which turns the lane into a permanent 2v1.
audit.corrected: Row 3 dropped to 4/10 and row 4 raised to 7/10 alongside the side flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wukong's slots are mixed up across the page: spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0] call the armour shred 'Nimbus Strike (Q)', wants.you[2] calls the dash 'his Q dash-in', and dosFull[0].d/breakdown call Nimbus Strike 'his escape'. All six do/don't bodies were generic filler under specific titles.
audit.why: Crushing Blow is Q (the armour shred), Nimbus Strike is E (the dash in), Warrior Trickster is W (the clone and the actual escape). A player who thinks the dash is the escape waits for the wrong cooldown before committing.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected in all four prose fields; the six do/don't bodies now state the clone, the shred, the Cyclone knockup, Mourning Mist's 12s cost of hitting a decoy, and Last Rites' auto reset.

edits.before: Wukong's spike is level 4 when Warrior Trickster (W) plus Nimbus Strike (Q) armour-shred lets him all-in; E in, Q to shred your armour, then autos. Bait the clone with your Maiden and E him so your ghouls collapse — if he blows W to disengage without a kill, he's just wasted his only escape.
edits.after: Wukong's spike is level 4 when Warrior Trickster (W) plus Crushing Blow (Q) armour-shred lets him all-in: Nimbus Strike (E) in, Q to shred, then autos. Bait the clone with your Maiden and E the real body so your ghouls collapse — if he spends W to disengage without a kill, his escape is gone.

edits.before: Land Nimbus Strike (Q) armour-shred then all-in at 4-5
edits.after: Land Crushing Blow (Q) armour-shred, then all-in at 4-5

edits.before: Pre-place W to zone his Q dash-in and R spin
edits.after: Pre-place W to wall Nimbus Strike and the R spin

edits.before: His escape. Cage it when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike is his way in; Warrior Trickster is the escape — bait both.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Wukong so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster leaves a clone behind him — hold Mourning Mist until the real body shows itself, then let the ghouls sprint at the mark.

edits.before: Wukong wastes Nimbus Strike — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Last Rites resets your auto and digs a grave — open every trade with it.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Mourning Mist is a 12s cooldown — spending it on a decoy hands him the trade.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow shreds your armour — trade before it lands, not after.

edits.before: Trading without ghouls or caging nothing — Yorick without the swarm is the worst duelist in the lane.
edits.after: Cyclone knocks you up repeatedly — never take that spin isolated from ghouls and Maiden.
